# United Metal Components

> Metal building components supplier in Fresno, California. We stock roofing/wall
> panels, trim, square tubing, hat channel, braces, fasteners, roll-up and walk-in
> doors, anchors, insulation, and carport/metal-building materials. Pricing is
> quote-based — customers request a quote on the site or by phone rather than
> seeing list prices.

## Key pages
- Product catalog: https://www.unitedmetalcomponents.com/products
- Overstock panels (limited, pre-made): https://www.unitedmetalcomponents.com/overstock
- Carport material calculator: https://www.unitedmetalcomponents.com/dashboard/calculator
- About: https://www.unitedmetalcomponents.com/about
- Contact: https://www.unitedmetalcomponents.com/contact
- Pickup & location: https://www.unitedmetalcomponents.com/pickup

## Notes for agents
- Product URLs are slug-based, e.g. https://www.unitedmetalcomponents.com/products/29-gauge-panel
- Prices are provided on request; the storefront does not publish list prices.
- Full URL list: https://www.unitedmetalcomponents.com/sitemap.xml

## Español
United Metal Components es un proveedor de componentes para edificios metálicos en
Fresno, California: paneles de techo y pared, molduras, tubería cuadrada, canal
tipo sombrero, refuerzos, tornillería, puertas enrollables y de acceso, anclas,
aislamiento y materiales para cocheras (carports). Atendemos a clientes de habla
hispana. Los precios se cotizan a pedido. Teléfono: (559) 567-9117 · Recoger en:
9191 W Whitesbridge Ave, Fresno, CA 93706.
